5.11.5.5.2 Task Dispatch
Description:
A trace event that is invoked immediately an RTE generated task
(containing runnable entities) has commenced execution.
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_01244] ⌈
void Rte_[<client>_]Task_Dispatch_<task>(void)
Where <task> is the name of the task.⌋(SRS_Rte_00045)
